messages.subject: Sino Logistics | Regional supply chains, ESG and strategic partnerships
messages.body:
Dear Sino Logistics Leadership Team,

Your integrated international logistics platform aligns closely with my experience leading regulated operations, ESG and country stakeholder priorities.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy.

I bring hands-on experience aligning ministries, regulators, communities, strategic partners and internal teams around complex investment and sustainability priorities. My recent work also includes energy-transition support and carbon-data governance.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional mandates across Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships or country leadership. I have attached a Sino Logistics-focused executive CV.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
